status: M13 phase A training plant (bipe/m13/plant.py). Fitted values adopted 21 October 2026; fit records in artifacts/m13/fit/, closed-loop validation in artifacts/m13/validation/.

simulation.basis: Starting point for the timestep study (1, 0.5, 0.25 ms). No noslip iterations: MuJoCo Warp does not run them.

drives.hip_belt_basis: Rotors folded into the leg hinges as armature (ratio^2 x rotor inertia about its axis). The full plant's hip belt mode is about 210 Hz (350 N m/rad on 2e-4 kg m^2), too fast for a 1 ms step with an explicit spring.
drives.knee_belt_basis: The 1:1 knee belt is a fixed tendon spring between the knee-drive hinge and the actual shin angle (hip + shin), with the M10 stiffness and damping; its mode is about 90 Hz. Lash: the spring's rest length is offset by half the lash on the side the standing load takes up (knee_lash static); reversals are not modeled.

friction.basis: null takes the full plant's load-free value: hip pretension bearing moment plus the RO40 rotor Coulomb term referred through the belt (ratio x coulomb_motor), the knee bearing Coulomb term, and the GL40 Coulomb term. The load-dependent bearing and belt-loss terms are left to the fit.

contact.basis: Tire: direct stiffness and damping. Starting stiffness is the secant of the full plant's Winkler law near the static wheel load (about 10 N at 26 um: secant 3.8e5 N/m, tangent 5.8e5 N/m); damping from the 0.3 restitution on about 1 kg. Fitted in phase A. Shell: a stiff standard reference; only terminations and first contact use it. Friction rows use their own standard reference (time constant 2 ms, twice the 1 ms step): with the normal's direct damping they crept at 0.03 m/s on the flat hold, with the wheels still.
contact.fit: Adopted 21 October 2026 from the closed-loop coordinate search (bipe.m13.fit fit, log in artifacts/m13/fit/search.log): start tire_solref [-2e6, -300] from a stiffness scan (1e6 and 2e6 removed the 3 Hz hold wobble that 5e5 showed; 4e6 rolled over at the 1 ms step), friction rows 2 ms, hip frictionloss load-free default. The search moved tire damping to -371.5, the friction-row time constant to 2.18 ms and the hip frictionloss to 4.25 mN m (score 1.130 -> 1.028); other parameters stayed. The knee lash offset was added after the search. Revised the same day: the fitted tire (-2e6, -371.5) chattered at 330-400 Hz (normal force 19.4 +/- 7.8 N, intermittent loss of contact), which made the 3-4 mm/s hold drift and cost the delay margin. A scan of stiffness and damping in a sensor-model hold (bipe.m13.fit-style traces, normal-force spread and contact slip) found chatter-free settings only at high damping: -5e5/-700, -5e5/-1000, -1e6/-1000 to -1200 at 1 ms (-1e6/-850 and -900 chatter; -2e6 chatters at every damping tried up to -1000 and falls at -2800). -1e6/-1100 is adopted, the middle of the clean band. The clean band is narrow; the Warp parity check must confirm it in float32. Revised again the same evening: with -1e6/-1100 the wheels hopped at about 20 Hz for 2 s after the 2 N s push in push_drive_+2 (288 ms unloaded between 4 and 6 s), while the full plant's tires stayed loaded (16.5-22.7 N). The full plant's material contact is about -2.9e5 x diagA at rest with damping ratio 0.36, so the direct reference was 3.5 times stiffer than the tire. Direct references near the physical stiffness chattered or hopped (-2.9e5/-270 to -5e5/-500); the mass-scaled reference [0.002, 1] (MuJoCo's default form, critical damping) kept the tires loaded after the push with a 0.24 N spread in drive, and lowered the closed-loop score to 0.50 (fit) and 0.53 (held out) from 0.69 and 0.98. Adopted.
contact.condim_basis: Condim 4 (sliding and torsional), no rolling row. Without noslip (MuJoCo Warp has none) the condim-6 rolling row is a soft torsion spring between wheel and ground: with it the 15 ms delay, doubled-noise drive step limit-cycled at 8.8 Hz from 12.5-13.1 ms of delay, where the full plant holds to 16.25 ms (falls at 17.5). noslip_iterations 5 or dropping the rolling row each restored it; impratio 10-30, stiffer or less damped friction rows and dt 0.25-0.5 ms did not. The rolling resistance (rolling_friction x standing load, about 1 mN m per wheel) is left out: as wheel frictionloss it also sticks at rest and nearly doubled the late pitch wobble after hold pushes (push_hold_+2 0.50 -> 0.90 deg peak to peak).

shell.basis: Each group of B3 exterior hulls is enclosed by one box (the smaller of the link-frame and principal-axis boxes) or a cylinder about the link y axis. The bumper skid and wheel rings keep their shaped faces (end bevels, dome) as convex meshes reduced to pad_hull_vertices hull vertices by farthest-point sampling (an inner approximation): a plain box skid touched the ground at its ends at the 17 deg pitch of the low-posture pushes. Robot geoms collide with the ground only.
